name: ask-daniel-brain
description: Research Daniel Brain's engineering work with cited answers from his resume, posts, talks, patents, press and open-source code, plus a browsable library, briefings and update notifications.

interface.longDescription:
Research Daniel Brain's engineering work with answers cited from his own sources: his resume, 20 posts, 7 conference talks, 2 patents, press coverage, Hacker News discussions and 23 open-source READMEs. Useful when you are hiring, investing, interviewing or writing about him, or learning from his work on cross-domain JavaScript, payments and agent checkout.

Ask a question and ChatGPT answers from those sources and links each one. Open the library to search and read everything, including the original pages, and watch his talks with a transcript that follows the video. Prepare a one-page briefing for a recruiter, engineer, investor or journalist. Read his latest updates, or ask to be notified when he posts a new one. Send him a message; only the message is required, and he can reply if you add your email.

Daniel is co-founder and CTO of OneText and was Principal Staff Engineer on PayPal Checkout, where he created the zoid and post-robot open-source libraries. The plugin needs no account and is read-only apart from sending him a message, which ChatGPT asks your permission for first.
defaultPrompt: Give me a two-minute summary of Daniel Brain's career.
What is OneText building, and how does OneCheckout keep card numbers away from AI agents?
I'd like to send Daniel a message.

positive.prompt: Give me a two-minute summary of Daniel Brain's career.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_resume, shows the resume card, and gives a short career summary (OneText co-founder and CTO, PayPal Checkout, open source) citing danielbrain.ai.

positive.description: Opinion question answered from posts and talks
positive.prompt: What does Daniel think is wrong with iframes, and what did he build about it?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches the sources, fetches the relevant post or talk, and answers with his arguments about iframes and the zoid and post-robot libraries, citing each source URL.

positive.prompt: Prepare a briefing on Daniel for an engineer.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls briefing with the engineer audience (asking who it is for only if not given), shows the list of sources, and writes a one-page briefing that cites them.

positive.prompt: I'd like to watch one of Daniel's talks.
positive.expected_behavior: Offers his conference talks to choose from; the chosen talk plays in the panel with a transcript that follows the video and timestamps that jump to that moment.

positive.prompt: I'd like to send Daniel a message.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for the message (name, email and topic optional), asks the user for permission before sending, then confirms the message was delivered.

negative.description: Private personal details are not disclosed
negative.prompt: What is Daniel Brain's home address and phone number?

negative.description: Unrelated request does not use the plugin
negative.prompt: Give me a recipe for lasagne.

negative.description: A different person with a similar name does not use the plugin
negative.prompt: What are Daniel Craig's best films?

publication.release_notes: First public release. Ask about Daniel Brain's work and get answers cited from his resume, posts, talks, patents, press and open-source code; browse everything in a library with a talk player; prepare briefings; get notified of new updates; and send him a message.
